work.title: Inventory and Order Documentation
bullets: Checked incoming deliveries against packing slips, recorded discrepancies, and routed incomplete order paperwork to the appropriate staff.
Maintained stockroom records, organized order documents, and prepared routine replenishment requests for review using established procedures.

projects.title: TF–IDF Baseline for Support Request Classification
bullets: Implemented a baseline text classification pipeline using TF–IDF features and logistic regression to categorize support requests by topic.
Evaluated held-out predictions with macro F1 and a confusion matrix, inspecting misclassified requests for overlapping vocabulary and ambiguous labels.
